acceptanceCriteria: Audit only reusable native-closeout Python wrappers, if any, for signal handlers raising InterruptedError inside subprocess communicate/select; preserve explicit exclusions for disposable or retired scripts.

Retain real SIGINT and SIGTERM witnesses proving ordinary descendants retire before an attempt release, including a child that ignores SIGTERM; preserve any failure and distinguish synthetic wrapper proof from actual native-gate qualification.
Resolve as an evidenced bounded tooling disposition or own a reusable repair; do not imply a Core/Tasks product defect from the confirmed temporary-wrapper bug.
body:
Observed 2026-10-01 during owner-authorized native0551 closeout preparation. Installed Core rc.1/build163 and Tasks developer build202; no installed binary was changed or causally implicated. A temporary Python wrapper signal handler raised InterruptedError while waiting in subprocess communicate. Actual SIGINT witness timed out at10 seconds because Python I/O retried InterruptedError. The prior temporary probe is preserved at /private/tmp/corvint-closeout-interruption-rfpkmy11/probe.py; no native lifecycle command was run. Initial sandbox ps denial is separate infrastructure friction, preserved with the first fixture at /private/tmp/corvint-closeout-interruption-gn6q4n5n; its owned process group was explicitly retired and read back absent.

Local scratch repair: handler raises KeyboardInterrupt, invoke owns a fresh process group, TERM plus bounded KILL escalation runs before failure-release/readback. /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/root-pr418-0551-native-closeout-adf.py SHA2561dc11445e7543ce9bb6ba717b5ea9a4a1540f3c5647a8de51da6afd7376f123a. Actual synthetic SIGINT/SIGTERM witnesses PASS at /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/root-0551-closeout-interruption-witness.json. Child deliberately ignores TERM; all ordinary descendants retired and heartbeat stopped. Owned probes are stopped.

This is a confirmed temporary-wrapper bug repaired locally and an investigation question about reusable tooling, not a confirmed Corvint product defect. Source evidence at public adf83582: internal/tasks/cli/lease.go:188 uses signal.NotifyContext for native gate run; internal/tasks/store/lease_gate.go:222 cancels its contained gate group; those native handlers are preserved. Synthetic proof is not actual native-gate or physical-cleanup authority. No public source repair, broad scan or new reviewer has been started for this question.
title: Tooling: audit Python closeout guards for swallowed interruption and descendant cleanup
